news.headline: Cloudflare Sinks 14% and Datadog 13% in a Week as Software Selloff Hits Cloud Stocks
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCloudflare stock fell 14% in the week to Oct. 30, and Datadog fell 13%, though neither company reported weak results.

news.headline: Cloudflare, Fastly, Oracle, JFrog, and Okta shares plummet, what you need to know
news.summary: A number of stocks fell in the afternoon session after underwhelming earnings reports from tech giants Amazon and Intel (after mediocre earnings reports from Alphabet and ServiceNow the previous day) sparked widespread investor anxiety regarding aggressive artificial intelligence spending and sustained cash burn.

news.headline: Dow Jones Futures: Stock Market Sells Off As Apple, Palantir, Midterm Elections Loom; What To Do
news.summary: Techs led another stock market sell-off. It's a time to be defensive. Apple, Palantir, jobs and midterm elections loom.

news.headline: Cloudflare CEO: Agent Traffic Will Be “a Thousand Times Human Traffic.” Its Pricing Has to Change
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCloudflare CEO Matthew Prince said on TBPN that agent traffic could reach a thousand times human traffic within five years if current trends continue. He expects agents to pay a tiny fee each time they access a page, and Cloudflare has already released a gateway that lets sites collect those payments.

news.headline: Cybersecurity Stocks Tumble in Tech Selloff. A Crypto Bombshell Should Have Helped.
news.summary: Investor fears over tech stocks, fueled by shrinking cash flows at Intel and Amazon due to AI spending, outweighed the impact of the Binance hack.
